description: Read the code module a scripted node runs and return it with its language (three.js or Blender bpy) and its params at their current values. It reads the module of an object, or of a window, door or column built from code; a room's id reads its floor script, the module that builds its floor finish; a slab's id reads its surface script, the module that builds its top's finish; a wall's id with face reads that face's script (face may be left out when only one face has one). Optional source evidence when the current module is needed. An edited module can be passed back with the same nodeId: to add_object for an object, to add_window / add_door / add_column for their respective kinds.

face.description: A wall's face whose script to read; needed when both faces have one.

nodeId.description: An object, window, door or column built from code, a room with a floor script, a slab with a surface script, or a wall with a face script.

name: get_source
title: Read object script
